rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Supabase RLS (Row Level Security) policy on the 'users' table contains a circular reference that causes infinite recursion when any query tries to check user permissions
reproduction_steps: 1. Login successfully via Supabase Edge Function
2. Navigate to any data page (Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures)
3. Observe console error: 'infinite recursion detected in policy for relation users'
4. All data queries fail with 500 error
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Fix the RLS policy on 'users' table in Supabase to remove the circular reference. The policy likely references itself or another policy that references it back.
